# Getting help with Corta

- Ask usage questions in [Discussions → Q&A](https://github.com/noah-qin/Corta/discussions/categories/q-a).
- If something goes wrong, check [Troubleshooting](../docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) first.
- Report a reproducible problem with the [bug form](https://github.com/noah-qin/Corta/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- Use the [feature request form](https://github.com/noah-qin/Corta/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) for a concrete request; discuss early ideas in [Ideas](https://github.com/noah-qin/Corta/discussions/categories/ideas).
- Report security problems privately through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
